subject: Novanet discovery — plan to re-engage / internal sync
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Novanet discovery — quick recap + ask before we bump

Team — thanks for the quick sync yesterday. I had a 45-min discovery with Hannah Cole (Director of AI Integrations, Novanet Therapeutics). They’re intrigued by predictable latency and cost controls for inference; priority is a regulated POC for research-modeling workflows (PHI-adjacent). They expressed timing uncertainty — procurement loop and internal legal are the gating factors.

Summary (high level):
- Use case: batch inference of anonymized clinical notes + embeddings for similarity search; occasional low-latency interactive experiments.
- Constraints: must support VPC/private deployment (data residency in us-east), SOC2 evidence required, SSO via SAML, retention/configurable logs.
- Budget: TBD — procurement will advise; likely wants dedicated capacity if results justify it.

What I need from you before I nudge them:
1) Marcus — confirm SSO + data residency feasibility and an estimated timeline for a short POC (2-week window). Also any blocker on model quantization for this workload?
2) Laura — CS: what on-call/handhold would we offer for a 2-week dedicated POC? Do we have a standard POC checklist I can promise?
3) Markus — are you comfortable offering a small credit or pilot package to accelerate procurement? If yes, what amount should I propose?

Draft bump email I plan to send next week (first pass attached): novanet-bump-draft.docx. I’d like to send a soft re-engage that reiterates value, offers a concrete POC path, and sets a low-commitment next step (15-min scheduling or approval packet).

Please reply with redlines or a quick thumbs-up by EOD today so I can finalize.

Thanks —
Jasmine
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 415 555 0123
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Novanet discovery — quick recap + ask before we bump

Jasmine — good summary. Quick technical notes: 
- SSO: SAML is supported; we’ve onboarded two customers this quarter with the same IdP (Okta). Integration time ~3 business days once we get a test SP/IdP record from Novanet.
- Data residency: we can pin nodes to us-east region in Private vpc deployment; if they want on-prem, lead time increases ~3–4 weeks for packaging.
- Quantization: 4-bit Q4 variants look good for throughput, but for biomedical accuracy I’d recommend running a short eval on their sample prompts. If they’re sensitive to any numeric differences, we should offer a small in-house eval run.

POC timeline (rough):
- Day 0–2: SSO config + account provisioning
- Day 3–7: baseline model run + initial embedding population
- Day 8–14: latency tuning, monitoring setup, handoff docs

No hard blockers on infra — will allocate an SE slot for onboarding. I’ll need a list of sample data and a test user for SAML.

— Marcus
Senior Solutions Engineer
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Novanet discovery — quick recap + ask before we bump

Thanks for the context, Jasmine. CS can support a 2-week dedicated POC with the following:
- Dedicated CS SME (myself) + SE time during onboarding (Marcus)
- Monitoring dashboard for tokens/cost and latency per route
- Weekly check-in (15–30m) to show progress and capture feedback

POC pre-reqs I’ll need from Novanet:
- Admin contact for SAML test account
- Sample dataset (anonymized) 10–50K records for embeddings seeding
- Success criteria (KPIs): mean latency < 250ms median for interactive calls, embedding recall @ top-10 > 0.75 (or their metric)

If Procurement insists on strict SLAs for the POC we can add a short addendum, but I don’t recommend that as a first step.

I’ve attached our POC checklist in the shared drive (link in hubspot). I can also draft the onboarding runbook for Novanet once Jasmine confirms scope.

— Laura
Customer Success Manager
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 11:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Novanet discovery — quick recap + ask before we bump

Team — happy to support. Approve offering a small pilot incentive to keep momentum. Recommend: $7,500 in platform credits + waived onboarding fees for the 2-week POC. If they commit to Dedicated within 60 days we can convert credits to a partial discount.

I can join the external call if we need to escalate procurement. Consider cc’ing me on the bump so I’m visible in case legal/procurement escalate.

— Markus
Sales Director
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 4 Mar 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Finalized internal go-ahead + bump draft (please final review)

Thanks all — incorporating notes. Final decisions: offer 2-week dedicated POC, $7.5k credits, SAML onboarding, us-east residency. I’ve attached the polished bump email (novanet-bump-draft.docx) and a summary discovery PDF (novanet-discovery-notes.pdf).

Draft bump copy below — please scan for anything that would trigger legal or procurement alarms before I send to Hannah on Mon 3/8: 

--- DRAFT BUMP ---
Subject: Quick follow-up & low-effort POC option for Novanet
Hi Hannah — enjoyed our talk last week. I wanted to check whether procurement or timing changed on your side and share a low-effort POC we can run to prove value quickly: a 2-week dedicated POC (US residency) with $7.5k in credits, SAML SSO support, and a short onboarding plan we’ll run with your team.

If that sounds useful I can:
- Send a one-page POC packet for procurement
- Book a 15-min alignment call to scope the sample data and success criteria

Would either Tue/Wed next week work for a short call?
Best —
Jasmine
--- END DRAFT ---

If no redlines I’ll send Monday morning and cc Markus.

Thanks —
Jasmine

Hi Hannah —

Hope you had a good week. I wanted to follow up from our discovery and see if procurement or internal timing has shifted on your side. We discussed a short POC to validate embeddings and interactive latency for your workflows — to make that low-friction, we can offer: 

- A 2-week dedicated POC hosted in US-East (data residency guaranteed)
- $7,500 in platform credits and waived onboarding fees
- SAML SSO setup (we’ve done this with Okta customers — Marcus can lead)
- CS + SE support during the POC (Laura and Marcus on the thread)

If helpful I can also send a 1-page POC packet for procurement (scope, success criteria, timeline, easy acceptance). I’ve attached the discovery notes and a draft packet for review.

Would you be open to a 15-min alignment call the week of Mar 15? Possible times: Tue 3/16 10:00am PT or Wed 3/17 2:00pm PT — tell me what works and I’ll grab time.

Thanks for your time — happy to be flexible on timing if you’re not prioritizing this right now.

Best regards,
